pullRequest.title: Cap coupon discounts at a plan maximum
pullRequest.body: Coupons can no longer take more than 30% off unless a plan allows more. `applyDiscount` now takes the percentage first and an optional `maxPercentOff`; the pricing tests are updated.
pullRequest.author: dana
pullRequest.commitMessage: Cap coupon discounts at a plan maximum

bug.summary: applyDiscount now takes (percentOff, amountCents) but buildInvoice in src/billing/invoices.ts, outside the diff, still passes (subtotal, coupon.percentOff): the subtotal is used as the percentage and the coupon percentage as the amount.
